values.description:
A splinter group of outlaws have broken off from one of the main gangs in the system and have been trying to strike out on their own. With the amount of trouble they've been causing its clear they're looking to establish a name for themselves as quickly as they can. It's going to be up to you and your support crew to put a stop to them.

Once your crew is ready, head over to [LOCATION] and engage with the gang. Not all of them will just be waiting there on site. Expect reinforcements to arrive once you begin your assault. Just be sure to stay until every last one of them has been take care of.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."

values.title: Orange Level Contract: Protect Our Client’s Interests
values.description:
The folks at [LOCATION] are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses.

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of 7 MG Scrip if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Reprisal Attack
values.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Med. Supply of Research Resource
values.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [DESTINATION].

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the 'Forager's Guide' in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Direct Medium Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 8 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Locate Missing Clients
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP51643
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Looking for an operative to confirm the status of a client. They and their partner missed a scheduled meeting and all attempts to contact them have proven in vain. Last we heard they were undertaking some business in [SYSTEM] and fear that they may be the victim of some unfortunate tragedy.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Be cautious while conducting your search. If the client did meet harm, it would be unfortunate for you to meet the same fate.

values.title: Critical Cargo Extraction
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Calling for a skilled contractor to recover a displaced shipment located at [LOCATION]. Client's hauler was transporting some high value cargo when they decided to respond to a distress beacon and got ambushed by a group of outlaws. The client believes their pilot is gone but their cargo could still be recovered.

The information we have so far is that you'll need a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers, a heavy-duty tractor beam for shifting the goods, as well as your support ships to help deal with the outlaws at the location.

Client will be expecting the completed delivery to be made to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Finishing The Job
values.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

values.title: Orison Relief: Medical Aid Delivery
values.description:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family... We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.

LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
values.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a [TARGET]. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that [LOCATION] is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

Stows out.

values.title: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
values.description:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens.

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a [TARGET], was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by [LOCATION]. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-546 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-425 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Junior Rank - Direct Extra Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 1 SCU in size.

Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Ship In Distress
values.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ship In Distress

WORK BRIEF:
Got an urgent distress call from one of the Miners Amalgamated crews I sent out, saying they’re under attack by a gang that ambushed their ship.

I need you to rush down there, board the [SHIP] and help protect my people out there.

Please let me know ASAP if you can help.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon elimination of all targets.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

values.title: Special Covalex Delivery Stanton System
values.description:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.

Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a handheld tractor beam and a ship with space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Good luck. I'm counting on you.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: CRITICAL FLEET REFUEL
values.description:
Heyo,

Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: They Will Be Missed
values.description:
A security officer by the name of [TARGET] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [LOCATION] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms.

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TARGET] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Steps
values.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space.

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Little Heavy Lifting at [DESTINATION]
values.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at [LOCATION] that have to be moved to [DESTINATION]. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t.

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

Stows out.

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Direct Medium Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 8 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
values.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

values.title: They Will Be Missed
values.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TARGET] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN NYX
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
values.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

values.title: Reclusive Bounty: [TARGET] | Extreme Risk
values.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
-------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT ---------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Extreme
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: Unknown
NOTES: This particular target has proven very difficult to capture. They tend to remain hidden unless there is a big enough threat to demand their attention. That's why you and your most trusted support fleet will need to take out enough of their underlings to force them to confront you. Just stay put, take out any hostiles that show up, and the target will eventually arrive in their capital ship.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

values.title: REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
values.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.

A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.description:

Looking for a contractor with a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to run a delivery for us across Stanton.

This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a handheld tractor beam to speed up moving the boxes.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno

values.title: Salvager Needed (Small Supply of RMC / Components)
values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job tractor beam. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

values.title: Looking For Trouble
values.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?

The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.

- Stows

values.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
values.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Orange Lvl. - RSI Ship Under Attack
values.description:
In search of a contractor to help us out of a tight spot.

We were hired by RSI to escort their ship to the Discovery event that's going on, but the moment the group dropped out of quantum, outlaws took out the escort. All we know is that their last known location was [LOCATION], but that's about it.

Not for the faint of heart this one, so bring back up and don't skimp on weapons. You'll need to cover them long enough so they can quantum to safety.

Good luck out there,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Red Wind Straightforward Cargo Recovery
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]

The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously.

EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.

values.title: Master Rank - Direct Bulk Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hey there,

So the People’s Alliance hired us to move a load of cargo from Levski to [DESTINATION]. Honestly, I’m surprised that they export some of this stuff, but I guess they must sell something to be able to afford everything they import.

For the run itself, you’ll need a ship that can hold 24 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to handle the containers. That should be it.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Green light on [TARGET]
values.description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TARGET] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at [LOCATION] who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TARGET] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TARGET], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

values.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Les Arlington
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.

Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Last Landings needs some repairs
values.description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at [LOCATION] got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but no more than three I think). If you can bring a salvaging tool with enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

values.title: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Small Scale Cargo Run
values.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride.

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at [LOCATION] that need to go to [DESTINATION]. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size 2 SCU containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on.

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill.

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

values.title: Hit a CFP Ship
values.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named [TARGET] who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around [LOCATION]. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

values.title: Treat yourself to a fight
values.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGET] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

values.title: [LOCATION] needs some repairs
values.description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at [LOCATION] got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but no more than three I think). If you can bring a salvaging tool with enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

values.title: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
values.description:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
values.description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Death and cargo
values.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

values.title: INFILITRATE ASD SITE AND DESTROY SERVERS
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.

Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s Energy Lab, located in the Research wing. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: A Well Deserved Break
values.description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all.

Start your search at [LOCATION]. These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
values.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

values.title: Lrg. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Bounty Assignment: [TARGET] (HRT)
values.description:
Hey,

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TARGET] has been located at [LOCATION].

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out.

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (4 SCU or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Client's Cargo Needs Recovering
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client's cargo was mid-transport when they ran into some ship trouble, and now a group of opportunistic outlaws are looking to cash in on this.

If you accept, head to [LOCATION] and deal with the outlaws guarding the cargo. Extract it using a heavy-duty tractor beam, recover the cargo, load it in to a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers, and deposit it on the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

This contract is non-negotiable.

values.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. values.title: Alliance Aid: Medical Cargo Haul - Large Scale
values.description:
Hello,

With the ongoing emergency in Levski, Alliance Aid needs all hands on deck to help transport enough medical supplies to save as many lives as possible. There's a large scale haul over at [LOCATION] ready to be brought to [DESTINATION].

This run needs a hauler with a ship that can hold 8 SCU cargo containers. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to deal with the crates.

Please let me know if you can handle this for us.

Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Orange Level Contract: [SHIP] Needs Assistance
values.description:
Got an orange level contract for any available combat pilots. A [SHIP] is under attack around [LOCATION] and is in desperate need for assistance. We're not sure how many perpetrators there are, but they seem motivated and dangerous so exercise caution.

Once on site, engage and destroy any hostiles you encounter and protect the client. Once they've transferred the credits, we'll route you your payment.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.description:

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

values.title: Junior Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in [LOCATION] that needs to go to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION] for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than 8 SCU.

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
values.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people.

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].

-Stows out

values.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Nicks Cantwell
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

We have received word that Nicks Cantwell, long-time acquaintance and confident of Maltrox Arlington, was spotted trying to purchase a high-density mining laser, the kind frequently used in past ship-jacking attempts to strategically breach hulls. We have provided coordinates for Nicks’ last known location.

Nicks is a highly regarded munitions expert among criminal circles and often leaves a path of destruction in his wake. It is advised to bring an increased level of firepower to this encounter.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Orison Relief: Strike Nine Tails Squad
values.description:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near [LOCATION] after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down.

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: [LOCATION] needs a bunch of repairs
values.description:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to [LOCATION] and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
values.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

values.title: Trainee Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we update our intel.

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old QV Logistics station.

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the encrypted data and use the decryption key to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Pilot in Distress
values.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [LOCATION] and they won't make it much longer without support.

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: JR. LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be required to lift up to .25 SCU in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Salvager Needed (Small Special Order of RMC / Components)
values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job tractor beam.

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

values.title: Red Wind Challenging Cargo Recovery
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Security Sweep
values.description:
Need someone to knock out a security patrol. You’ll need to go to the location marker on your HUD and then scan several designated waypoints ensuring that they’re safe and secure.

Satellites in that region have been acting up recently. Not exactly sure what’s going on out there, but best be prepared in case there’s any trouble.

Complete this contract and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 4 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 4 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

values.title: Simple Hit
values.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGET] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION] and you should find [TARGET] flying around.

Stows out.

values.title: Collect Irradiated Kopion Horns
values.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver.

There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near [LOCATION]. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect irradiated kopion horns and deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: Provide Protection at [LOCATION]
values.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at [LOCATION] comm'd to let me know that their [OBJECTS] are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any friendly ships unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.

values.title: Red Wind Package Recovery
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A contractor of ours has run into some trouble and abandoned their ship over at [LOCATION]. We need someone to head to their ship, pick up the package they left there, and finish the job.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 1x [ITEM1]

DROP OFF LOCATION

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Medium Cargo Haul (Medical)
values.description:
I hope this message finds you well,

Things are a bit crazy than normal around here because of how many of our pilots ended up getting sick while doing runs to Levski. Thankfully, Covalex is contributing to 'Alliance Aid' so hopefully we can put this whole affair behind us soon.

Currently, I've got a medium scale haul of medical supplies waiting at [LOCATION]. Really need someone to take it to [DESTINATION], so the team there can operate at full capacity.

The biggest container on this run will be 4 SCU in size, so have a ship that can handle those. Oh, and don't forget your handheld tractor beam.

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Small Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. values.title: Complete Stranded Ling Shipment
values.description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Red Level Contract: Clear PAFs, Recover Cargo, and Deliver to OLP
values.description:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2], but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers. It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-985 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

An emergency contract just came through about a gang of violent thugs wreaking havoc on one of our VIP clients’ infrastructures. If available, we need you to rush to [LOCATION] and defend the client’s extremely valuable [OBJECTS] at all costs.

Foxwell is extremely aware of this group, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to survive the encounter with the client’s property intact, we’re adding 9 MG Scrip any main contractor brave enough to take this job on.

Stay safe, and good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

values.description:
Here’s the deal. Dead Saints need some new blood to help shift gear across the ’verse and if you can prove yourself useful, you could make some nice creds doing it.

Got an easy one to start you out. Couple of hours ago, something went down over at [LOCATION] and a pilot of mine got ghosted. My tracker’s telling me that they didn’t find the stash of gear in there.

If you can get out there, get the package back and take it to [DESTINATION] without dying, I might have some more work for you. Can’t see you running into too much trouble as any ships you spot will likely be scavs looking for a quick cred. I’m sure you can take care of that.

-Twitch

values.description:

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area.

Lima Endicott

values.title: Orange Level Contract: Take Out Fuel Supplies
values.description:
We're in need of a sharp contractor for a hit and run operation. Client says some local thugs have been congregating in concerning numbers and we have been tasked with disrupting their base of operations.

Get on over to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel tanks. If you're successful we can set these folks plans back a while, and most importantly, without having to deal with them directly.

Reports are showing there's a couple of ships buzzing around the area and some defense turrets. Just focus on the fuel tanks and you should be alright.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

-Stows out

values.title: Stand Our Ground
values.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.

Stows out.

values.title: Collect Irradiated Valakkar Eggs
values.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver.

We are therefore seeking a contractor to secure an irradiated valakkar egg. Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near [LOCATION] that will take you inside the storm. One more thing, analysis indicates that these eggs will decay over time, the state of the egg shouldn't affect our research but sooner would be better.

Due to the health risks associated with radiation exposure that will be needed to deliver a viable sample, Rayari is ready to pay well for anyone who can safely secure and deliver this item.

Once attained, please take this valuable resource to [DESTINATION].

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: Obtain Irradiated Valakkar Pearls
values.description:

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar pearls, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION]. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls.

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
