ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a [TARGET] which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the [TARGET] is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft.

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an emission cloud that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Enforcer
values.description:
We have intercepted a location beacon that puts [TARGET] and their personal attack wing at [LOCATION]. They have been one of XenoThreat's most brutal enforcers since their founding.

[TARGET]'s not one to back down from a fight so hit their ships hard enough, do enough damage and they won't be able to resist joining in the action. Once they're out in the open, they'll be your main target.

Ready to go?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Easy Pickings
values.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: Deliver a Message
values.description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to [LOCATION].

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us.

Stows out.

values.title: Trainee Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Stand Our Ground
values.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.

Stows out.

values.title: Hot Shot
values.description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

values.title: Secure Our Airspace
values.description:
Our airspace around [LOCATION] has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus 5 Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

values.title: Scan And Mining Needed
values.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Scan And Mining Needed

WORK BRIEF:
I have a job here that might interest you. I need people to go out and do some basic mining in order to pull some geological data for future prospecting. Need someone to scope out and mine [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. You'll be helping us out massively. [RARITY]

Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi that you should check out.

Keep me posted.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

values.title: Time to Teach a Lesson
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular [TARGET]. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good.

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by [LOCATION] on the regular, which has an emission cloud that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the [TARGET] could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Wanted: [TARGET]
values.description:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named [TARGET] just came out of hiding and was spotted at [LOCATION].

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure [TARGET] doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Package Recovery (Exp. E)
values.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
RECOMMENDED EXPERIENCE LEVEL – ENTRY

PICKUP LOCATION – In need of a Courier to retrieve lost package from a derelict RSI ship located at [LOCATION].

DROPOFF LOCATION – After recovery, deliver to the RSI Event Platform.

THREAT LEVEL – Light engagements are possible.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Wrecked Ships for Sale
values.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [LOCATION]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.

Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

values.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
values.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

values.title: Goods for the Getting
values.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you.

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
values.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
values.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGET] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGET] was spotted flying around [LOCATION], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.

values.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
values.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:

For reasons our client was unwilling to disclose, a rather prominent member of the People’s Alliance needs disposing of. The target, [TARGET], was last seen at [LOCATION] piloting a high-class ship accompanied by several skilled allies.

Do make the most of this opportunity.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

values.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
values.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Moderate Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit [LOCATION] which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

values.description:
Heyo,

Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.

values.title: Reprisal Attack
values.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

Travel to [LOCATION] and verify the status of [TARGET]. If they are deceased, examine their body and we will pass the information on to the client.

values.description:

Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?

It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

values.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

values.title: Tactical Strike
values.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

values.title: Get My Gear Back
values.description:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

-Twitch

values.title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
values.description:
CFP think they’re safe over at [LOCATION] but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.

Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

Thank you and be safe out there,

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

-Twitch

values.description:

These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat.

I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

values.description:

The dumb sods are trying to cripple the place by taking out their [OBJECTS]. I'm not having it.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

values.title: REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
values.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.

A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Pilot in Distress
values.description:

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Back up needed at outpost
values.description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against [LOCATION] so we're looking for people to go fend them off.

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.

You'll need room for at least 8 SCU cargo containers in your hold. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded and unloaded.

And as a fair warning, the things you'll be carrying are pricey enough that you might attract some unwanted attention. Be ready to defend yourself if you can't evade.

Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 6 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Finishing The Job
values.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].

Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in [DESTINATION]. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

values.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
values.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

values.description:

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TARGET], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle 4 SCU cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Member Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Greetings,

Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 4 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]

Drop-offs can be done in whatever order works best for you.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
values.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
values.description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.

Make your way to [LOCATION] whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 10 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

values.description:
--------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------

PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]

LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

values.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Red Level Contract: Save Ships at [LOCATION]
values.description:
Ship support is needed at [LOCATION] immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.

Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip if all goes down without a hitch.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Reprisal Attack
values.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

values.title: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
values.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet they're still in the area.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

values.title: Hunt Bounty: [TARGET]
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received a tip on the location of a high-profile bounty. Intel reports have tracked [TARGET] to [LOCATION]. We need a contractor heading in that direction on the double before the target vanishes. According to the latest reports, they were last seen near the [LOCATION].

Come prepared to use lethal force if [TARGET] resists apprehension.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Red Wind Seeking New Couriers
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind is excited to announce that we are looking to hire new couriers to help with deliveries across the ’verse. We pride ourselves on been a flexible company that’s eager to meet the needs of all clients, everywhere. We’ll ask no questions; if you want it there, we’ll get it there. If that sounds like you, we have an introductory contract to see if you’re the right fit.

We need a resilient new hire to head to [LOCATION], recover the package abandoned by a former employee, and finish the delivery.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 1x [ITEM1]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]

If you’re able to handle this contract we’d be delighted to send you more courier opportunities.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

values.title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo
values.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Grab ‘n’ go
values.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

values.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
values.description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

values.title: Shut Off Power at [LOCATION]
values.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

values.title: NEW HIRE: Locate Missing Person
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation.

Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION], search for [TARGET], and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.

values.title: Headhunter Pilot Needs a Hand
values.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [LOCATION]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

values.title: Primo Target
values.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGET] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGET] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

values.title: Tactical Strike
values.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

values.title: Hunt Some Heads
values.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.

- Stows

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Small Cargo Haul (Medical)
values.description:
Hey,

There's been an uptick in demand for medical supplies since the Molina mold outbreak started. That's why the medical team at [DESTINATION] is running low on a few essentials and can't wait for their regular restock. Any chance you're available to do a priority run there now?

Goods are ready and waiting at [LOCATION]. It's a small scale haul, but you'll still need a handheld tractor beam. Looks like the containers will be as big as 1 SCU in size.

Hope its a safe and smooth haul for you,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Stop Deadly Ship Attack
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to [LOCATION]. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
values.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Medium Cargo Haul (Filters)
values.description:
Hey,

There's a medium scale haul of new vent filters at [LOCATION] waiting to go to [DESTINATION]. You available to handle it?

The team at [DESTINATION] is obviously very anxious to get these new filters, and won't stop bugging me about this haul until I give them a delivery ETA. No wonder with how worried everyone is about this Molina mold outbreak. Should be an easy run. All that's needed is a ship that can hold containers 8 SCU in size or smaller, and a handheld tractor beam.

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
values.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life.

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet.

Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

values.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
values.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Minor Repairs Needed: Chawla's Beach
values.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at [LOCATION] is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need three fuses replaced and if you could bring a salvaging tool with enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ship Under Attack
values.description:
Foxwell is looking for an available combat pilot to provide immediate assistance to a [SHIP] under attack over by [LOCATION]. We have not identified the perpetrators in the attack, but have been assured it is a small force.

Please dispatch quickly and clear out all hostiles. We need the client to make it through this as they haven't paid us yet.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Moderate Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit [LOCATION] which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Red Wind Seeking New Haulers
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind is looking to bolster our roster of haulers. Need someone who can keep their wits about them and keep quiet. If you check those boxes, and have a ship that can handle 8 SCU cargo containers, then give this trial run a shot.

PICK UP
Freight elevator at [LOCATION].

DROP OFF
Freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Complete this contract and we’ll send more hauling opportunities your way. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Cargo Transfer from Shuttered Facility
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

values.title: Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Stand Up to Aggressors
values.description:
Outlaw ships are harassing anyone attempting to land or leave our client’s operations at [LOCATION]. Need someone to fly there to defend the site and protect our client’s ships before the situation gets out of control. Get there, get after those aggressors, and I'll keep you updated on the situation.

Help take care of this and we'll pass along a bonus payment of 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

Before they cut out, they told me that the ships that attacked them weren’t your standard transporters. These assholes are rocking some serious weaponry. Bring a crew, get my shit, and take it to [DESTINATION]. This whole thing is such a mess that I’d be willing to fork out some extra creds if you can get this done.

-Twitch

Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].

We've gotten word that [TARGET] was spotted flying near [LOCATION] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR23665
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Operative with extensive combat experience needed to retrieve a blackbox from a compromised ship at [LOCATION]. Client hasn’t specified why they need it but are paying good money to have it back.

Analysis of the wreck indicates that there are some serious hostiles in the area, so any attempt to retrieve will likely require a fight. Our records indicate that these hostiles are highly trained and aggressive, so prepare accordingly.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Route to [LOCATION] and secure the blacbox by any means necessary. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION] for payment.

Additional Notes:
Operations wanted to reiterate that this will be a heavy combat mission so make sure you bring allies or equipment to handle it.

values.title: A Very Difficult Task
values.description:
An tricky assignment has just arrived that I think you will be ideally suited for.

Expect to encounter [TARGET] aboard a heavily armed vessel near [LOCATION] and accompanied by some of the most highly-seasoned pilots that can be hired.

Deal with the escorts as you wish. As long as you kill [TARGET], I will be more than satisfied.

Respectfully,
Vaughn

values.title: New Opportunity - Ambush Strike
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a [TARGET] and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified [LOCATION] as the ideal spot to intercept them. values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-879 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [LOCATION]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-563 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Additional Resources For Research
values.description:

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager

values.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
values.description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to [LOCATION] to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 12 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire.
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to [LOCATION] to give ‘em some support?

-Stows

values.description:
Hey,

The folks at [LOCATION] have what I like to call a “pilot’s special” waiting to be distributed - a haul of quantum fuel, hydrogen fuel, and ship ammo. Load it up from a freight elevator and deliver it to the following spots in whatever order works best for you. Expect the containers to all be 4 SCU or smaller.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Finish the job
values.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

values.title: Secure Fuel Tanks From Rivals
values.description:
Our friends at [LOCATION] have been compromised. A new gang in the area are threatening them by targeting their [OBJECTS].

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 4 Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

values.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
values.description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship
APPROVAL CODE = RT-05

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It seems that the People's Alliance aren't the only ones eager to get their hands on the resources needed to fight their Molina Mold outbreak. The Moraine gang has been hitting the shipping lanes hard trying to get their hands on as many haulers as they can. One particular member, [TARGET], and their crew have been especially successful, knocking over over a dozen ships. The folks organizing Alliance Aid are pretty eager to see this growing problem dealt with.

Recent reports have their hunting grounds over near [LOCATION]. Head there with any support ships you want to take and neutralize them before any more vital supplies are lost.

This contract is non-negotiable.

Contract’s come through to look into a recent attack near [LOCATION]. Client claims that they were ambushed by a serious outlaw pack and need the proof. An operative with significant combat experience is needed to fly to scene and retrieve blackbox.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Find site of derelict ship at [LOCATION], secure the blackbox, and deliver to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Expect heavy resistance from outlaws present on the scene. As such, this has been flagged as a combat mission.

values.description:
Hi there,

The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of Tungsten into containers 16 SCU or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]

Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect Fuel Tanks and Escort Employees
values.description:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS] and ships. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.

If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 3 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Goods for the Getting
values.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you.

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: Moderate Repairs Needed: Shepherd's Rest
values.description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to [LOCATION] with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so. That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Guard Fuel Tanks At All Costs
values.description:
Our partners at [LOCATION] need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the [OBJECTS] there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order.

With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Hauling ask.
values.description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry 4 SCU cargo containers. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

values.title: Extra Small Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
values.description:
Hi,

So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at [LOCATION]. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] you'd be doing me a huge favor.

Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such.
