values.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
values.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGET] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

values.title: Verified Bounty: [TARGET] | Very Low-Risk Target
values.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: [DANGER]
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:
NOTES: They have several known associates with criminal records so they may not be alone so arm up and exercise caution when engaging.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Courier Needed
values.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at [LOCATION]. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [DESTINATION].

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. Medium level engagements expected.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.

values.title: Jorrit Dossier: Lab Sample
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
In going through the files, I’ve seen a couple of allusions to a specific lab sample that would potentially be useful to have our people analyze. Not sure where it is exactly, but if you hunt around Onyx Facility you should be able to find the sample and bring it to me.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Onyx Facility Research Wing and track down the Lab Sample and deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Eliminate Known Outlaw
values.description:
Greetings,

A high value criminal named [TARGET] has recently been spotted for the first time in several months and we've been hired to intercept them. With a long history of ship theft and homicide, it seems far too coincidental for them to just suddenly make a reappearance considering the number of high value ships on display at the current RSI Discovery Month event locations.

Our analysts have reported their last known location was [LOCATION]. We are seeking a contractor to track them down and eliminate them.

Payment and additional work to follow upon your success.

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Pick Up, Put Down
values.description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION].

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
values.description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Protection against [TARGET]
values.description:
Reports indicate that [LOCATION] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TARGET]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support.

Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TARGET] is not there to lead them.

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION] - Multiple Boxes
values.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Incursion
values.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [LOCATION] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.description:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named [TARGET]. We've tracked them to [LOCATION], so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you.

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

values.title: Cargo Retrieval
values.description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a 32 SCU load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.

values.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION]
values.description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

-Twitch

values.title: Alliance Aid: Urgent Rescue Mission
values.description:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack.

We need you to hurry to [LOCATION], neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Looking For Trouble
values.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?

The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.

- Stows

Transportation must be provided by courier.

Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
values.description:
Wikelo has another way to get favors if you interested.

Your Mercenary souli has scrip metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATIONS], will trade for favor.

Bye.

values.title: Silence the Xenothreat
values.description:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to [LOCATION] and climb the comm towers there. Should be a control panel at the top you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.

Stows out.

Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

Battaglia, Recco

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION].

values.title: Easy Pickings
values.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

----------------------------

They're doing a clean out at [LOCATION] and have a bunch of 32 SCU or smaller waste containers that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots. (Don't ask me why. They're paying us is all I know.)

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
- [LOCATION 4]

And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a contractor who’s available immediately.

A client conducting business in Nyx ran into some trouble with the Shattered Blade and is requesting back-up at [LOCATION]. Are you free to handle this for us?

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
values.description:
Hi,

Guess the folks at [DESTINATION] are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to 8 SCU.

Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Recover Package from Hijackers
values.description:
Greetings,

Outlaws have conducted a targeted attack on a courier that was due to deliver a crucial package to one of the RSI Discovery Event locations. Contact has since been lost with the pilot, but the tracker still appears to be functional. It is crucial that we act now whilst the trail is still warm.

Scanners are suggesting the package is located somewhere at [LOCATION]. Whilst we have no intel on the situation on the ground, what we do know is that you should expect resistance. Ensure you are well prepared and prioritize the retrieval of the package.

After you have successfully extracted the package, deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Starfighter Inferno Special
values.description: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.

values.title: Need a Hauler
values.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle 4 SCU cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hello, the People's Alliance is committed to providing opportunities to miners, prospectors, and salvagers in the system and have an exciting opportunity to offer you as a welcome to the system.

If you're interested just accept the mission and come by to see me.

Standard listed rate upon completion of tasks.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

values.description:

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

Got a moment? Need someone to fly over to locate [RESOURCES] and mine at least [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. We're updating our database for future mining expeditions. You can keep what you find, we just need the data. [RARITY]

Also, if new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out in your mobi.

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

Battaglia, Recco

values.title: Salvager Needed (Small Special Order of RMC / Components)
values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job tractor beam.

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, partly in thanks to how many outlaws are flying around in Pyro and partly because this request isn't for your average everyday component. But lucky for you, the extra effort will be rewarded.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

values.title: Protect Fuel Tanks From Luggers
values.description:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.

values.title: Extensive Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION] - Multiple Boxes
values.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Stand Our Ground
values.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.

Stows out.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Small Cargo Haul (Cryopods)
values.description:
Hello,

I’ve got an extremely important and sensitive hauling order here that I’m hoping you can handle. To reduce fatalities from the Molina mold outbreak, those suffering from the People’s Ailment are being put into cryopods to keep the disease from progressing before they receive the necessary treatment.

Can you head to [LOCATION] to pick up a small scale haul of cryopods and bring them to [DESTINATION] so they can get the help they need?

If you haven’t dealt with a cryopod before, you’ll need a ship with a hold that can fit a container up to 2 SCU in size. A handheld tractor beam will also be needed to move them around.

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Wrecked Ships for Sale
values.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [LOCATION]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

Stows out.

values.description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at [LOCATION] but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to [DESTINATION] and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

values.description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at [LOCATION]. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and a heavy-duty tractor beam you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll send you the creds.

values.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Minor Repairs Needed: Sunset Mesa
values.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at [LOCATION] is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need three fuses replaced and if you could bring a salvaging tool with enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of the folks over at [LOCATION] just hit me up about a pile of cargo, 4 SCU or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: XL Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Ground The Upstarts
values.description:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to [LOCATION] and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

values.title: Death and cargo
values.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

values.title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
values.description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to [LOCATION] and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: [DESTINATION] Stroll
values.description:
Any chance you’re at [DESTINATION]?

Need a box hustled from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.

-Smokey

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Chase Hewitt

values.title: Salvage Wrecked Ships on the Drift
values.description:
Got word there’s a few ships near [LOCATION] just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.

If you want the coords, we’ll sell them to you for a price. Then you’re free to pick the wreck as clean as you like and sell it all for a tidy profit. Now, you might run into some trouble out there from rival scavs, but I’m sure it won’t be anything you can’t handle.

- Smokey

values.title: Salvager Needed (Med. Special Order of RMC / UCM / Components)
values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job tractor beam.

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

values.title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Security Data
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
Out of an over-abundance of caution, it would be good to see if the security systems have picked up anything new since the last batch of data you delivered. That way we can make sure we’re up-to-date on what’s been happening down there.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing and retrieve the Security data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a ASD Secure Drive that you can collect at your home location.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Double Interstellar Med. Haul (Medical / Filters)
values.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to [DESTINATION].

To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to 2 SCU in size.

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
values.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.

values.title: [DESTINATION] Errand
values.description:
Got a box sitting at [LOCATION] that needs to make its way over to [DESTINATION]. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.

values.title: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.

Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

values.title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks
values.description:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: PURGE ASD SERVERS
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client has asked us to infiltrate an old ASD research site and wipe the contents of a few specific servers there.

We believe the servers are located somewhere within the Xenotech Lab, in the Research wing. The client has also informed us that despite the facilities being publicly declared as closed, you're still likely to find hostile forces there.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
